## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List relevant commands and real scenarios, exact environment/model versions, and pass/fail. State any check that was blocked or not run. Documentation-only changes usually do not need model inference.

## Remaining limits

Mention compatibility, permission, recovery, or other behavior that remains unverified.

- [ ] The change preserves existing user work and the neutral worker capability.
- [ ] No credentials, private project data, raw exports/logs, generated installation, or machine-specific configuration are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and public verification claims match the actual evidence.
